name: PGC 50395 (Hubble)
blurb: PGC 50395, a slowly rotating early-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: pgc050395-hubble
story: The core of PGC 50395 spins in the opposite direction to the galaxy around it. Hubble's sharp view found no flattened core of light at its center, a hint that gas helped build it.

claims.text: PGC 50395 is one of the 12 slowly rotating early-type galaxies (ATLAS3D slow rotators) imaged by HST program GO-13324
PGC 050395 was targeted as a low angular momentum early-type galaxy

Hubble imaging showed the 12 newly imaged slow rotators, including PGC 50395, have core-less central light profiles, consistent with formation through accretion of counter-rotating gas or gas-rich mergers
